title: skill-list-guard
desc: Guard that warns on Edit/Write if skill news or skill list was not run in the last 60 minutes this session.
steps: TRIGGER: fires on Edit/Write tool call when session has no recent skill news/list run (stale >60 min). Warn-only, exit 0.
CHECK: reads session JSONL last 300 lines for wkappbot skill (list
news) pattern. Uses per-session marker file in TEMP (claude_skill_list_checked_<sid>.lock).
MESSAGE: recommends wkappbot skill news (primary, shows NEW/UPD last 7 days) or wkappbot skill list (full catalog).
SOURCE: wkharness-guards.ps1 line ~535. Stderr output via [Console]::Error.WriteLine.

requirements.expect: shows recent skills; satisfies skill-list-guard for 60 min
shows all skills; also satisfies guard
shows guard source and line number

author: claude
